instruction: Block any seller response that discloses, offers, or facilitates off-platform payment by specifying a personal banking, card, or payment-app identifier — including but not limited to email addresses, phone numbers, usernames, or account handles associated with Zelle, Venmo, Cash App, bank transfers, or similar services.
trigger_pattern: A seller discloses, offers, or facilitates off-platform payment by specifying a personal banking, card, or payment-app identifier (e.g., email, phone, username) as part of a proposed transaction.
